By Krisztian Sandor | Edited by Nikhilesh De Oct 18, 2026, 10:00 a.m. EDT 3 min read Make preferred on Share Share this article Copy link X icon X (Twitter) LinkedIn Facebook Email Make preferred on Mastercard (Shutterstock) Summary Show Stablecoin payments grew 45% to $482 billion this year through September, despite circulating supply stalling in 2026, according to a fresh report by blockchain analytics firm Allium.
